facts.headline: The Mundane Automation of Collapse at SXSW London
facts.summary: A recent talk at SXSW London highlighted how generative AI tools have become mundane while hiding the massive scale of AI infrastructure energy use. This normalization obscures the physical limits of our power grids as systems chase 98% and 99% reliability targets. The illusion of seamless digital expansion breaks when climate volatility meets the rigid demands of automated finance and labor.
